fixed_features.justification: Knowledge point and tutorial 3950 explicitly concern one-pivot systems; adding rank or inconsistency would change the family.

shortcut_probes.cue: Only signs distinguish the five normalized top rows
shortcut_probes.strategy: Read signs of coefficients and RHS of first equation; multiply each sign by sign of x coefficient; select the unique matching top-row sign triple. Ignore all magnitudes and remaining equations.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Random selection among five choices succeeds0.2. Sign arithmetic is part of the skill, but universal identical option magnitudes disclose every numerical ratio and remove normalization arithmetic from the entire delivered practice family; source banks include magnitude errors. This is a restricted family/batch, not a claim that sign reasoning itself is invalid.
